vendor: MOSIP — Modular Open Source Identity Platform

sources.notes: ID Repository module — UIN/VID + WebSub publication
eSignet — OIDC-compliant authentication for relying parties
Token seeder used by the OpenCRVS-MOSIP mediator pattern

notes: MOSIP uses W3C WebSub (Ballerina WebSubHub) for internal event distribution between modules. External integration requires either (a) deploying a WebSub subscriber within / alongside the MOSIP cluster with proper partner onboarding, or (b) polling REST APIs (ID Repository, Resident services). eSignet provides OIDC for relying parties — request/response, not event-driven. DataShare creates temporary URLs for sharing credential data; it is used inside the credential issuance pipeline rather than as an event source.
